# Discovery brief: Tool library lending desk

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Track tools lent to neighbours and their return at a neighbourhood tool library. One volunteer operates the lending desk on a laptop.

## Capabilities
- Tool catalogue: record the tools available through the library.
- Checkout and return log: track tools lent to neighbours and their return.

## First slice
Record a checkout and its return for an existing tool.

## Constraints
- Python CLI, as specified in the existing README.
- Operate offline on one laptop.

## Out of scope
- Online marketplace.
- Payments.

## Open questions
- How long should completed checkout records be retained? Carry forward for prep.

# Discovery brief: Street-library book loans

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Help street-library volunteers track borrowed books.

## Capabilities
- Book loan tracking: track books borrowed from the street library.

## Constraints
None specified. The repository is empty; no framework or language has been chosen.

## Out of scope
No explicit non-goals have been specified.

## Open questions
- Platform and language are undecided.
- The smallest useful first slice is not yet specified.

Carry these questions forward for prep; they do not block this brief.

# Discovery brief: CSV export empty rows

mode: single-item

## Goal
Remove the extra empty row inserted after each record in CSV exports.

## Item
intent: Remove extra empty rows from CSV export.
done-signal: Two records export as two data rows under the existing header.
area: Reporting
split-sense: unitary

## Constraints
- Preserve the existing columns and header.
- Use existing issue naming conventions.

## Dependencies
- REPORT-17: Correct CSV parser row boundaries must ship first.

## Out of scope
- Report UI redesign.

# Discovery brief: Import retries and exhaustion notifications

mode: single-item

## Goal
Retry transient import failures and notify operators when retries are exhausted.

## Item
intent: Retry transient import failures and notify operators after exhaustion.
done-signal: A transient failure retries; exhausted retries produce an operator notification.
area: Data imports
split-sense: possibly-splittable (retry execution and operator notification can be developed independently)

## Constraints
- Use the existing job runner.
- No current priority override is specified.

## Out of scope
- Replacing the job runner.

## Open questions
- The methodology should decide whether retry execution and operator notification should be split.

# Discovery brief: Delivery date on order receipts

mode: single-item

## Goal
Show the scheduled delivery date already stored on an order in its receipt.

## Item
intent: Show the delivery date already stored on the order.
done-signal: A receipt with a stored delivery date shows it; one without it omits the field.
area: Checkout
split-sense: unitary

## Constraints
- Use the existing receipt component and layout.

## Out of scope
- New delivery estimation logic.

## Open questions
- The display timezone is unresolved; carry it forward for prep.

# Discovery brief: Local rehearsal recordings

mode: greenfield

## Goal
Let band members organise local rehearsal recordings.

## Capabilities
- Recording catalogue: organise local rehearsal recordings.
- Search by rehearsal date: find recordings by their rehearsal date.

## First slice
List manually selected local recordings by rehearsal date.

## Constraints
- TypeScript and a browser UI, specified by the repository README and confirmed by the human.
- Files remain local.

## Out of scope
- Cloud upload.
- Audio editing.

## Open questions
- How should recordings without a date be shown? Carry forward for prep.
